messages.subject: Getting Unstandardized Values in CFA
parts:
Hello All,

I would like some help on how to get unstandardized values for my loadings in CFA as I want to calculate H and Omega? I don’t want the first loading to be 1 so I can calculate reliability for loadings and errors for my measure.

Thank you for your help.

Katalin

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Getting Unstandardized Values in CFA
parts:
Katalin

The estimates are always unstandardized, the difference is you method of factor identification. If you want to use fixed factor variance (having the factor variance equal to 1) instead of marker variable add the argument std.lv=T to the cfa call

Also, you can use the function reliability from the semTools package to estimate Omega
